question: The main items of ________ expenditure are interest payments, defence services, subsidies.
solution:
The correct answer is __**non-plan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main items of **non-plan expenditure** are** interest payments, defence services, subsidies.**
 
• Non-plan expenditure refers to the **regular expenses** incurred by the government, which are not related to any specific plan or project.
 
• Interest payments include the **interest paid on loans** taken by the government, such as external debt and domestic debt.
 
• Defence services include expenses related to the **maintenance and modernization of armed forces**, as well as the payment of salaries and pensions to defence personnel.
 
• Subsidies include various types of **subsidies given by the government,** such as food subsidies, fertilizer subsidies, and fuel subsidies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Waste expenditure** refers to the expenses incurred on activities that** do not **contribute to the welfare of society, such as corruption and unnecessary administrative expenses.
 
• **Plan expenditure** refers to the expenses incurred on **specific plans or projects**, such as infrastructure development and poverty alleviation.
 
• **Household expenditure** refers to the expenses incurred by households on various** goods and services,** such as food, clothing, and housing.
